co_squirming_coil_area.blurb: A small cluster of 17 boulder problems on the Dark Side hillside near Morrison, Colorado, at roughly 5,500 feet. The boulders sit on a level bench beside the steps that climb the slope, a short uphill hike from the road. Most problems fall between V1 and V3, with a handful in the V4 to V7 range and one far harder outlier, so it suits a mixed group better than a pure project crag. The bench gives some flat ground for pads and spotters, though a few of the taller lines still land awkwardly near the path. Expect a quick session rather than a full day, and plan to pair it with neighbouring sub-areas.
